name: markcopy
displayName: MarkCopy: Rich Markdown, CSV & PDF Preview
description: One-stop Markdown, CSV, and PDF preview with right-click copy: rich text, per-element (code / table / diagram), raw Markdown, CSV/TSV, and PNG.
author: OK Studio

commands.title: MarkCopy: Open Rich Preview to the Side
MarkCopy: Copy Whole Document as Rich Text

editor/context.when: editorLangId == markdown || editorLangId == csv || editorLangId == tsv
editorLangId == markdown || editorLangId == csv || editorLangId == tsv

explorer/context.when: resourceLangId == markdown || resourceLangId == csv || resourceLangId == tsv

markcopy.styleProfile.description: Rendering style. 'github' matches GitHub markdown (best for pasting into docs/email).

markcopy.syncScroll.description: Keep the preview scroll position in sync with the editor.

markcopy.autoPreview.description: Automatically open the MarkCopy preview to the side when you open a Markdown, CSV, or TSV file. The preview follows the focused editor and keeps your cursor in place. Turn off to open previews manually.

enumDescriptions: Follow the VS Code color theme.
Green text on a black background (terminal style).
markcopy.theme.description: Preview color palette. 'auto' follows your VS Code theme; 'light', 'dark', and 'green' force a palette. Copied rich text stays light either way.

markcopy.mermaid.markdownDescription: Extra [Mermaid configuration](https://mermaid.js.org/config/schema-docs/config.html) merged into `mermaid.initialize` (for example `flowchart`, `fontFamily`, `themeVariables`, or a fixed `theme`). Diagrams already follow the light/dark palette by default; set `theme` here to override.

markcopy.math.markdownDescription: Render LaTeX math with [KaTeX](https://katex.org). Inline `$...$` and display `$$...$$` become equations you can right-click to copy as an image or as LaTeX. Turn off for documents that use literal dollar signs.

enumDescriptions: Detect the delimiter from the file's contents.
markcopy.csv.delimiter.markdownDescription: Field separator for the CSV/TSV preview. `auto` picks whichever separator splits the file into the most consistent columns.

markcopy.csv.headerRow.description: Treat the first row of a CSV/TSV file as column headers. Turn off for files that start straight into data.

markcopy.csv.maxRows.description: Maximum number of CSV/TSV rows to render. The preview says how many rows it is hiding; raise this to show more, at the cost of a slower preview on very large files.

markcopy.pdf.browserPath.markdownDescription:
Path to the Chrome, Edge, or Chromium executable used to render the PDF. Leave empty to detect one automatically; set it if yours is installed somewhere unusual. When no browser can be found, 'Save as PDF' falls back to opening the preview in your default browser to print by hand.

This setting is machine-scoped: it can only be set in your own user settings, never by a workspace, because its value is launched as a program.
